text:
alex: Seeing weird pack/unpack in us-west2.a — tiny pods getting stuck on old racks, evictions ramping.
maya: yep noticed. warm node handoff lag + our new rack-reserve is holding older small-slot pods. Can repro with >50 tiny-gang jobs.
alex: Logs show attach-detach latency 1.2s -> 15s spikes. Could be conntrack/egress in that AZ.
ops-bot: Alert: scheduler_latency_p99 in us-west2a > 1500ms — auto-scale not triggered (min=2)
jamie: Is this the label rollout? I pushed affinity-labels yesterday that pin pods to 'rack:set-a' for locality.
maya: Yes, that rollout created micro-islands. Combined with rack reserve padding it's causing rack-level fragmentation.
ashwin: typo in earlier name, ignore
ashwin: (actually ashwin) NVLink locality constraints mean we can't spread some model jobs across racks without perf regressions. That limits our options.
ashwin: Cost callout: capacity in the region is fine, but NVLink locality constraints mean we can't spread to other racks unless we relax affinity.
alex: Proposal: temporary relax affinity for tiny-gang=high-prio to allow cross-rack coalesce. Rollback in 2h. Thoughts?
jamie: Sounds good. Add a canary rule: only affect pods with annotation `infra/allow-relax=true` and set `preemptible=false`.
maya: Also need to drop the warmnode attach timeout to 8s to reduce handoff backlog. Current default 30s.
alex: Command I'll run: ```kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge --patch '{"data":{"relax_affinity":"true","attach_timeout":"8s"}}'```
ops-bot: Deploy started: scheduler-config patch by alex at 1764443340. CI job 4321 passing.
jamie: Monitoring: I'll watch p99 latency + eviction-rate. If eviction-rate > 0.8% revert.
maya: :thumbsup: will also run a quick binpack sim against last 6h traffic to estimate cost delta.
ashwin: If cross-rack increases network egress, we should set routing policy to prefer same-az with relaxed affinity as fallback.
alex: Thanks. I'll patch now and post back with metrics. If anything flares, alert on #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded. scheduler rolling update started.
alex: Update 10m: p99 down from 1.6s -> 0.9s, eviction-rate dropped from 1.2% -> 0.3%. Keeping for 30m.
jamie: Can we formalize the canary as a rollout doc? I'll draft PR with config and rollback steps.
maya: Adding follow-up: need long-term fix for label rollout - we should gate label migration on warmnode saturation metric.
ashwin: Noted. Create JIRA and assign to scheduler team.
ops-bot: Ticket created: SCHED-4721 by ashwin
